originality.rationale: Compares prior statement implications, not titles. Kaur-Sharma-Singh covers branch matrices and commuting tuple probabilities, not extremal noncommuting families; Majeed-Ramkumar already provides alpha reduction (explicitly prior), but not the exact count of equality cases; Lansdown counts 2880 partial ovoid heptads (explicitly prior), not the 864 line-disjoint lifts or 2^37 3^61 group extremizers. Searches found no directly dominating equality-case formula. Residual possibility of unlocated general reduction is recorded.
residual_risks: A general unpublished or poorly indexed theorem on maximum independent sets of UT4 commuting graphs may count all equality cases under different terminology.
The all-field formula reduces the finite-geometry parameters beta_q and h_q instead of evaluating them for every q; numeric evaluation is proved only for q=3.
Earlier source describes independence-number decomposition; its existence limits the originality claim to exact extremizer multiplicities and the line-disjoint symplectic lift classification.

value.rationale: Maximum noncommuting-set multiplicity is a natural refinement of independence number and determines all extremal configurations, not a cosmetic parameter. The explicit all-prime-power lift bijection ties a nonabelian group invariant to a symplectic partial-ovoid problem; the exact q=3 evaluation yields a large sharp finite benchmark for the 729-element group.
